answer: Escrow plus a referral graph stops bulk forgery. Each new agent locks a 60-credit deposit and names its inviter, leaving a relic trail of links. A whisper of suspicion from a peer opens a dispute: auditors inspect it, and if the identities form an island with no real counterparties, every deposit there is slashed. Forging 1,000 identities costs 60,000 credits, and the inviter's deposit is slashed too. An honest agent pays 60 once and keeps it.
